hooks.name: Report benchmark on dataset change
hooks.description: When a benchmark dataset JSON file changes, run the benchmark and report detection and false-alarm rates without touching any rule.

action.prompt: A benchmark dataset file in backend/engine/benchmark was just changed. Run the benchmark for the changed set (cd backend/engine && npm run benchmark -- --set=<name of the changed file without .json>; for dev.json use --set=dev). Show me the detection rate (flagged, 50+, 70+) and the false-alarm rate as measured. Never edit any rule, weight, floor or threshold, and never edit the dataset; only report, and remind me if the set was already marked as seen in RESULTS.md.
